summary.text: Darren Fix is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he is a computer programmer who served in the U.S. Navy from 1989 to 1993.

paragraphs.text: Darren Fix served in the U.S. Navy from 1989 to 1993, and his career experience includes working as a computer programmer, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Texas, came to Montana in 1999, worked for a couple of years in Seattle for large technology companies, and moved back to Kalispell in 2006.
He said he has spent over 30 years as a computer programmer, has served as a CASA advocate for children in foster care, has volunteered with hospice, and has taught children to code after school.

Fix listed fully funding public schools and paying teachers, keeping public lands public, and a first bill banning elected officials from serving as officers of a political action committee among his campaign priorities.
